import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 我的故事指令处理器
 * 指令：/我的故事
 * 展示玩家数据统计与故事化诠释
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/story/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const result = await App({ uid, bid });

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText('故事加载失败，请稍后再试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '我的故事', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { items, name, canShowMemoryButton } = result.data;

  md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${name}，这是你的故事。`));

  items.forEach(item => {
    md.addText(`【${item.label}】${item.value}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(item.flavor));
  });

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '我的故事',
      content: md,
      footer: canShowMemoryButton ? [{ label: '我的回忆', command: '/我的回忆' }] : undefined
    })
  );
});
